result.summary: Found 2 issues: a missing Orders tab icon in the bottom navigation and a missing restaurant name on a popular listing card.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon so all tabs have a consistent icon-plus-label treatment.

issues.description: The second Popular listing (pizza with a -20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or cuisine details under the image, unlike the card above it.
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant title and metadata below the image so the listing is identifiable and consistent with other cards.
